intro.title: The Pumpkin Oracle
intro.welcome: Carved by moonlight, lit by a stolen flame. Ask, and the pumpkin shall answer… if it deems you worthy.
intro.candles: Only five candles burn for you, and each question or card reading consumes one. Use them wisely: once all five go out, the oracle falls silent and you can do nothing more until 24 hours have passed.
intro.hint: The oracle hears better in silence.

name.title: Who dares to wake me? Tell me your name, mortal... I will not forget it.
name.label: Stay nameless
name.error: The oracle cannot answer a nameless soul.

micError.denied: The oracle cannot hear you: allow microphone access.
micError.network: The network spirits are silent. Type your question.
micError.generic: The microphone failed. Type your question.

greeting.named: Ah, {{name}}... I have been waiting for you. I am the Pumpkin Oracle, keeper of secrets carved by candlelight. Ask, and I shall answer. Or, if you prefer, let the tarot cards speak for you.
greeting.nameless: A stranger... how delicious. No name, only questions. I am the Pumpkin Oracle, keeper of secrets carved by candlelight. Ask, stranger, if you dare. Or, if you prefer, let the tarot cards speak for you.

answer.thinking: The flame stirs… the oracle is listening to the spirits.
answer.error: The spirits are silent tonight. Ask again, mortal.

tarot.title: Choose your cards
tarot.hint: Tap up to 3 cards from the fan. Tap them again to return them.
tarot.hintFull: Your reading is complete. Tap a card to change it.

fool.name: The Fool
fool.meaning: A leap of faith; begin without fear.

magician.name: The Magician
magician.meaning: You have the tools; use them.

lovers.name: The Lovers
lovers.meaning: A choice born from the heart.

hangedMan.name: The Hanged Man
hangedMan.meaning: A pause and a new perspective.

death.name: Death
death.meaning: An ending that opens a new beginning.

tower.name: The Tower
tower.meaning: Sudden change that sets you free.

experienceApprentice.name: Experience Apprentice
experienceApprentice.meaning: Every experience is a new lesson.

experienceCreator.name: Experience Creator
experienceCreator.meaning: You turn ideas into living experiences.

candles.out: The candles have burned out… Return in {{time}}, mortal.
